paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
notes: Astrophysical (non-DM) search for axion-photon coupling via MWD polarization. Most constraining MWD is SDSS J033320+000720 with |g95_aggamma|=1.7e-12 GeV^-1 for ma < ~2e-7 eV (nearly mass-independent below ~10^-6 eV, suppressed at higher masses). Encoded as flat line spanning validity range. Other MWD limits: J190132 (Lick) 1.0e-11, J190132 (Keck) 1.6e-11, J002129 5.7e-12, J100356 4.2e-12 GeV^-1. No DM density assumption (relativistic stellar axions). | selector: figure_vision over table (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 27)) | Vision: Red curve (j033320+000720, Lick) is the most constraining limit.
